Discover nonzero ERC-20 holdings on one configured Alchemy Portfolio network, with exact decimal USD ranking, filters and live pagination. Excludes native currency and NFTs.

Authenticated natural-language task preparation. First request freezes an unsigned payload and returns a payment challenge valid for at most five minutes and never beyond the frozen build expiry without calldata. Retrieval requires the same principal, quoteId and private retrievalToken plus Payment-Signature, or recovery of an already accepted purchase. Supplying Payment-Signature additionally requires payments:submit scope. The service never signs wallet transactions or executes Task actions. Paid frozen artifacts are recoverable for 30 days from first durable payment acceptance; retries do not extend retention or transaction validity. Mainnet payment is disabled unless explicitly enabled by deployment.

transactionSafetyMode.description: EVM transaction safety selection. Initial build, stage, and Task requests default to balanced when omitted. Simulation and commit inherit the sealed Build selection when omitted; an explicit override requires a fresh assessment and review.

maxOutgoingUsdcWei.description: Maximum gross outgoing native USDC in 18-decimal base units, represented as an integer string.

maxGasUnits.description: Maximum simulated gas units across all actions.

allowedTargets.description: If nonempty, every action target must be in this allowlist.

asset.description: Currently supported: native (18-decimal USDC units) or Arc USDC precompile 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 (6-decimal units). Other assets fail closed because received-balance evidence is unavailable.

amount.description: Minimum net increase in the sender balance across the simulated batch, in the specified asset's base units.

idempotencyKey.description: Required in body or Idempotency-Key header.

200.description: Exact frozen JSON artifact bytes (build, report, safe summary and pricing), released only after payment acceptance. Payment-Response is returned when available; accepted is distinct from batch settlement.

202.description: Payment submitted or ambiguous; retry the same quote/token for recovery. Artifact remains private.

402.description: Safe summary, pricing, quoteId, expiresAt, SHA-256 payloadHash, EdDSA attestation, retrievalToken and base64 Gateway paymentRequired. No build/calldata/full report.

409.description: Request key conflict, active preparation, or incompatible payment replay.

PipelineOperation.description: Callable operation descriptor with a Catalog-sourced input schema

regenerate.description: Durable completed assistant message_key in this session. Append a response-only restatement with all tools disabled; preserve history and transaction outcomes.

mode.description: Execution policy. Omit for Auto unless app or applicationId selects a Direct target.

cursor.description: The caller's current event cursor. When supplied, the start page carries only events after it instead of the whole history; an expired cursor falls back to the full page rather than failing the accepted turn.

UserState.description: Client-owned provider, wallets, preferences, and extension values only.

broadcaster.description: Selected submitter. Auto selects hosted before assembly; an explicit wallet selection is invalid for Auto. App policy still bounds this choice.

supported_transports.description: Additive capability advertisement. Absence on an older cached view means the legacy sign-and-broadcast route.

oneOf.description: Historical cached-view compatibility; new views use sign plus supported_transports.

runtime_sequence.description: Optional runtime ordering hint for reconciling live text; never a durable cursor

commitStages.description: Server-authored ordered durable Commit Service stage references. Clients must resolve all references and use Commit Service; never fall back to a direct wallet send.

maxNetworkFee.description: Maximum network cost in native base units, separate from application fees and principal.

include_tx_history.description: Also return recent transactions; the heaviest part of the call.

history_limit.description: Max transactions when include_tx_history is true (default 100).

execution.description: Present when policy routes the connected owner through an ERC-4337 executor account.

address.description: Contract address. Pass the zero address together with metadata fields to search instead.

chain_id.description: Chain ID; required alongside a concrete address.

mode.description: `abi` returns parsed signatures; `source` returns verified Solidity (heavier).

auto_resolve_proxy.description: Follow EIP-1967/OZ proxies through to the implementation's metadata.

chain_id.description: Configured EVM chain with Alchemy Portfolio indexing enabled.

holder_address.description: Optional wallet address. Omit to use the backend-resolved execution account; pass an explicit address to inspect that address exactly.

limit.description: Page size (default 20). For top N assets, set N here and sort_by=usd_value, sort_order=desc.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous response. Keep chain, holder, filters and sorting unchanged. Pages are live, not a snapshot.

sort_by.description: Default usd_value. Never rank different tokens by raw balance.

sort_order.description: Default desc. Unknown USD values always sort last under usd_value.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of token symbol, name or contract address.

min_usd_value.description: Nonnegative decimal string filtering known USD values. Unknown values are retained if include_unpriced=true.

include_unpriced.description: Default true: keep assets with unknown USD value, including missing decimals. False excludes them.

complete.description: True when all indexer pages were traversed; incomplete traversal returns an error. Does not imply price coverage or a stable snapshot.

PipelineEvmContextRequest.description: No parameters; send an empty JSON object.

arguments.description: ABI arguments as strings; encode nested tuples/arrays as JSON strings.

to.description: Target contract address or ENS name.

value.description: Native value in wei for payable simulations. Defaults to 0.

from.description: Sender for the simulation. Defaults to the connected wallet's execution account; pass explicitly to dry-run as an arbitrary address.

chain_id.description: Chain override; defaults to the connected wallet's chain.

PipelineEvmEncodeCallResult.description: Human-readable simulation report: the decoded return value or a state-change preview.

decoded.description: Typed decode: user, token_account, mint, program_data, anchor, or a raw base64 fallback.

program_id.description: Base58 program id. Pass null for name search.

name.description: Fuzzy program-name search when program_id is absent.

mode.description: `idl` includes the full IDL JSON; `metadata` omits it.

idl.description: Full IDL JSON; present in `idl` mode, null when unavailable.

owner.description: Base58 owner. Defaults to the connected SVM wallet.

mint.description: Filter to one SPL mint. Mutually exclusive with program_id.

program_id.description: Token program to scan; defaults to the classic Token Program. Ignored when mint is set.

include_token_2022.description: Merge classic and Token-2022 accounts when no mint/program_id filter is set.

holdings.description: Per-mint aggregation of the raw token accounts.

PipelineSvmContextRequest.description: No parameters; send an empty JSON object. Requires a connected SVM wallet.

recent_prioritization_fee_microlamports.description: Cluster-wide mean priority fee in micro-lamports per compute unit; null when the RPC sample is empty.

next.description: Opaque continuation link for the next deterministic catalog page.

PipelineLifecycleRequest.description: Build request, explicit stage input, or a complete portable Build envelope depending on the endpoint.

transactionSafetyMode.description: EVM transaction safety selection. Initial build, stage, and Task requests default to balanced when omitted. Simulation and commit inherit the sealed Build selection when omitted; an explicit override requires a fresh assessment and review.

origin.description: App, skills, and Catalog operations that assembled the actions.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp after which commit is rejected.

attestation.description: Server authentication of the Build owner, app scope, status, and simulation guard evidence. Older attestation versions require a new stage and simulation.

transactionSafetyMode.description: Transaction safety selection sealed into this EVM Build digest and attestation.

guardEvidence.description: Server-authored exact operation evidence carried unchanged with the sealed EVM Build.

status.description: Legacy preparation response label; returned CommitViews describe the durable cohort, which may already be invoked on replay.

provider_invoked.description: This preparation endpoint did not invoke a provider. Returned CommitViews own the current cohort lifecycle.

requests.description: Durable Action requests with ordered commitStages. Continue through canonical CommitViews; replay may recover an already invoked cohort.

requests.description: Validated wallet intents; no durable Agent Action IDs. The wallet provider has not been invoked. SVM transactions are exact-byte simulated independently; ordered cross-transaction state dependencies are unsupported.

aomiOAuth.description: Better Auth OAuth 2.1 authorization-code/device grants. Access tokens are exact-resource bound; the Portal BFF verifies them and delegates a downscoped internal bearer.
